content:
### **Two Programs, One Territory** 

SIT Nexus™ is the integrated program combining SIT GroundForce™ structured neighborhood outreach with SIT Engage™ brand activation — deployed in the same defined territories, for the same brand, at the same time. 

The premise is simple: recognition built at the neighborhood level and recognition built at community events are more powerful together than either is alone.



### **A Practical Scenario** 

Consider a home services brand activating in Highland Park and the surrounding North Shore suburbs. The GroundForce™ component runs weekly: Territory Representatives building door-level recognition, leaving personal notes for homeowners who are not reached, holding prevention-focused conversations. 

The Engage™ component runs at the Highland Park farmers market and community events: the same brand, professional ambassadors, face-to-face conversations with the same homeowner population. 

A homeowner encounters the brand at their door in June, then again at the Saturday market in July. Neither encounter alone converts. Together, they create the layered familiarity that makes the brand feel established, local, and trustworthy — and a follow-up conversation gets scheduled. 

### **Why Synchronicity Matters** 

The programs are designed to work off one another. Event conversations reference neighborhood presence. Neighborhood conversations reference the event booth. Every touchpoint reinforces the others — which is why Nexus™ territories consistently develop recognition faster than either program deployed alone. 

### **Program Design** 

Every Nexus™ program is custom designed — components sized to the client's category, geography, and season. Pricing is structured as separate GroundForce™ and Engage™ line items or a combined blended rate depending on program design.
